title: Two-tier Help Desk architecture and authority
summary: The Help Desk owns conversation/session routing; NotNotes owns TPS business semantics, persistence, relationships and workflow. Provider-owned specialist surfaces are discovered dynamically rather than copied into the chatbot.
invariants: The Help Desk is not a shadow NotNotes application.
NotNotes semantic application/document projections are authoritative for formats, reports, relationships and feasible actions.
Instrumentation is read-only evidence and cannot mutate NotNotes workflow.
The LLM is recognition fallback only and cannot dispatch business mutations by itself.
procedure: Begin each user turn by rediscovering the live NotNotes semantic application projection.
Give business/report/document semantics first refusal before operational specialists.
Route understood application requests through NotNotes Intention Service/domain operations.
Use provider-owned specialist relevance/evidence without copying specialist vocabularies into Help Desk code.

provenance.claim: Accepted two-tier Help Desk architecture, dynamic NotNotes discovery and read-only Instrumentation specialist integration.
